decisions.subject: Ancillary lot coverage: City used 10 percent, our R-zone text says 5 percent
decisions.recommendation: No recommendation. The quoted text does not decide it. Readings: Reading A: the City's (10 percent) — The parking-space exception in 10.10.60.70(1)(B) takes buildings that contain parking spaces out of the 5 percent cap, so the base rule 10.5.60.70(1)(B), 10 percent, applies. This is what the City used on A0180/26TEY. | Reading B: ours (5 percent) — The R-zone rule 10.10.60.70(1) says 'may not exceed 5% of the lot area'. The exception we have text for names parking-space buildings but states no figure of its own, so 5 percent stays.
